{"chunk_id":"895aee","wall_time_seconds":0.000007333,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":5052,"output":"# 插件与扩展子系统

**状态：目标架构／尚未交付。** 本轮只建立文档和检索入口，不实现公共SDK、MCP Client/Server、插件安装器或隔离运行时，也不执行第三方代码。当前五个运行系统见[软件目录](README.md)，本系统在目录中单列为规划。目标依据为[产品基准](../product/PRODUCT-FOUNDATION.md)、[0483核心边界](../adr/0483-ai-plus-core-product-and-extension-boundaries.md)及[0484现行修订](../adr/0484-extension-contracts-and-deferred-agent-development-access.md)。

## 按问题定位

| 问题 | 章节/权威细则 | 状态与边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 插件能提供哪些功能 | [目标职责](#职责与状态权威)、[扩展面契约](../product/specs/model-extension.md#adr-0154) | 先选少量命名能力验证，七个参考面不是已冻结MVP |
| 其他软件怎样接入/MCP是什么 | [协议与宿主](#协议与宿主边界) | 入站服务、出站工具连接和可安装插件是不同范围，协议不替代领域契约/隔离 |
| 开发、安装、启用、禁用、更新/卸载 | [目标生命周期](#正式入口与运行链) | 开发与安装/执行/发布许可分别处理，尚无交付流程 |
| 权限、原件、结果与用户数据 | [失败与保护](#失败取消与兼容保护) | Host统一授权/写入，插件只提议结果；卸载不删既有用户资料 |
| 当前可复用代码与缺口 | [源码与详细机制](#源码与详细机制) | 内部Client/IPC是复用线索，不是公开SDK或第三方授权 |
| 怎样证明首个插件闭环 | [验证与维护](#验证与维护) | 未来实施任务按真实插件、目标平台和实际入口存证，本轮不冒充验收 |

## 职责与状态权威

插件系统的目标职责是公开版本化能力、发现/协商兼容、管理插件包及激活生命周期、在隔离边界执行，并将工具/UI贡献接入正式用户流程。详细贡献面仍以原契约和0484明确替代范围为准，本页只组织系统关系，不新建第二份SDK字段/权限Schema。

| 拥有者 | 插件可请求/提议 | 不下放的权威 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Host与系统集成](local-host.md) | 有范围的输入句柄、命名能力调用、任务/进度与取消 | 会话/来源/角色、授权/撤权、文件访问与实际进程/交付生命周期 |
| [资料库](library-lifecycle.md) | 元数据建议、派生素材/导出提案，经审查后提交 | 原件、人工内容、库身份/修订/事务与正式结果；不能直写SQLite |
| [AI能力与执行](ai-system.md) | 适用分析提供者、按既定服务/模型的受限调用 | 外发目的地、费用、资源准入、结果验证；插件包/模型制品/Runtime身份分开 |
| [GUI](gui-shell.md) | 已声明命令/面板等受限贡献 | 主Renderer/Preload权限与任意Store，不得伪造应用授权对话框 |
| 插件子系统（目标） | 清单/版本兼容、能力绑定、隔离单元、配额与生命周期记录 | 不取代上述业务/信任拥有者，也不开放通用终端/文件/SQL接口 |

基础标签、描述、OCR和确定性配色仍是核心能力，不要求用户先安装插件；录屏、专业处理等可选能力按产品范围选择。安装、激活、能力就绪与信任是独立状态，不能用一个enabled代表全部资格。

## 正式入口与运行链

以下为目标流程，不是当前可点击功能；具体首批插件、语言/运行单元、UI插槽、包格式和稳定兼容承诺仍须结合实际消费者确定，不在文档任务冻结。

1. **开发**：模板/Schema/类型/示例与测试 → 明确开发工作区 → 校验/打包。开发授权不默认包括真实库、凭据、执行生成代码或发布；外部AI开发连接器仍按0484暂缓范围处理。
2. **安装/更新**：用户选择来源/包 → 看兼容性与权限 → 完整校验与暂存 → 原子登记；失败保留旧版本。权限扩大的更新不能自动激活，签名不代替安全/质量验证。
3. **激活/执行**：用户动作或独立声明获准的后台条件 → 当前能力/授权/资源复核 → 隔离运行 → 受控输入与有界结果 → Host验证/审查/事务提交 → 回读与可理解反馈。结果“收到”和“正式保存”分开。
4. **禁用/撤权/卸载**：拒绝新准入 → 取消或收敛在途任务 → 等待实际终态 → 撤销注册/句柄。既有用户素材及归属明确的结果保留；插件缓存、用户创作数据和明确删除数据意图按契约分别处理。

### 协议与宿主边界

公共业务契约与传输解耦。MCP可作为工具/资源适配候选：DAM调用其他软件需要出站Client，其他软件调用DAM需要入站Server；带面板/预览/生命周期的插件还需要扩展运行时。MCP不自动提供运行时、推理API或授权引擎，不保证其他宿主插件原包直接运行，具体版本/传输留实施时核验。

可选命令、分析、声明式UI及Host审核的派生/导出提案见0484；不能把完整市场、计费、云开发、全部贡献面和旧候选语言矩阵当首个插件闭环的前置，也不能用此理由取消隔离/权限/数据保护。未来浏览器Producer不恢复已退休网页/素材下载执行器。

## 失败、取消与兼容保护

第三方代码不在Main/主Renderer/Preload以完整权限加载；独立进程本身不足以证明隔离。校验来源/权限、限制输入句柄、路径/网络目的地、并发/字节/时间/资源及结果大小；不把原件路径、凭据或内部IPC交给插件。对应细则见[0155权限](../adr/0155-extension-permissions-use-tiered-consent-and-update-reapproval.md)、[0156隔离](../adr/0156-third-party-extensions-run-in-isolated-execution-cells.md)、[0158撤销](../adr/0158-extension-revocation-is-risk-classified-and-non-destructive.md)。

授权/库代际/输入版本变化使旧句柄失效；任务取消/超时不等于插件进程退出或远端零费用，UNKNOWN不能盲重发或假释放。崩溃不能破坏Host/用户数据，卸载不抹去历史来源与已提交结果。稳定API承诺须明确兼容/迁移政策；首个稳定SDK之前标实验性，不虚构旧ADR的支持窗口已对外承诺，已实际发布的承诺仍须兑现。

## 技术与平台边界

插件代码包、数据型模型制品、可执行Runtime和外部工具服务各自有身份/信任/升级/资源生命周期，不因共用下载或JSON合并。普通扩展贡献、敏感权限、外发范围和开发工作区授权分别披露；一次可信审查可以包含多个明确授予，不要求重复弹窗。

Windows/macOS按实际目标验证安装/执行隔离、系统交付、取消/退出、UI及兼容性；Browser共享UI不替代原生行为。文档存在不授予下载/安装模型、启动服务或读取秘密；正式推理验收继续只用现有模型。

## 源码与详细机制

当前有可复用内部能力，下表不表示已有公共实现或可立即授予第三方：

| 已有入口 | 可复用责任 | 尚需插件专项补齐 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Host模块](../../src/main/local-host/README.md)、[命名Client](../../src/shared/client/workspace-client.ts) | 正式业务/会话/事务与传输边界 | 公开小契约、外部身份/授权、版本发现与协议适配；不直接公开WorkspaceClient |
| [Copy入库](../../src/main/capture-intake/README.md)、[Library](library-lifecycle.md) | 计划/审查、来源验证、原件及结果持久化 | 插件专用staging/结果提案、归属与失败恢复 |
| [AI连接](../../src/main/ai-gateway/README.md)、[AI系统](ai-system.md) | 既定推理适配、取消/资源与验证 | 第三方权限绑定、隔离/限额和实际插件协议；Pi不等于插件执行器 |
| [GUI系统](gui-shell.md)、[交互正文](../design/INTERACTIONS.md) | 统一界面语言/可见用户路径 | 声明式插槽、隔离UI、安全消息和卸载后的界面收尾 |

原[2026-09-13讨论稿](../product/PLUGIN-PLATFORM-DISCUSSION-20260913.md)保存SDK、安装、参考插件等设想，后续[0484](../adr/0484-extension-contracts-and-deferred-agent-development-access.md)控制具体替代范围；[0154详细契约](../product/specs/model-extension.md#adr-0154)保存贡献面/例外，其他决定由[扩展目录](../adr/indexes/topics/model-extension.md)选择。讨论稿中的示例SDK/旧采集建议不当现行API。

## 验证与维护

未来明确实施先选一个真实插件/外部软件与命名能力，验证“可见发现/选择 → 权限及输入范围 → 实际隔离执行 → 结果预览/审查 → Host保存回读 → 取消/撤权/卸载保护”。读/写/网络边界、坏包/版本/权限升级、崩溃/超时/旧句柄、用户编辑/旧结果与平台资格分别存证。带UI的贡献按DESIGN/INTERACTIONS和真实视觉/交互验收，不以一个tools/call返回成功代替插件系统完成。

本轮只验证文档可发现/用对及规划状态准确，公共API/SDK、安装与隔离、MCP互通和完整插件生命周期均不因本页宣称通过。没有自动实施队列或新平台；实际能力和候选资格仍见[CURRENT-STATE](../handoff/CURRENT-STATE.md)，证据归各实施任务。修改目标取舍核对已有ADR，修改AI材料按[三层行为验收](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#document-retrieval-validation)，产品细节写回其原规格而不复制全文。
# Extension Contracts And Deferred Agent Development Access

Status: Accepted (2026-09-14). Target architecture; no public Extension API, development API or MCP server is delivered by this ADR.

The application will expose versioned, capability-specific contracts around assets, analysis
results, tasks and scoped UI, with one host-owned authorization and write boundary. Built-in
features and optional providers can share those contracts. Development agents and browser
connectors are consumers through adapters, not replacements for the host or permission engine.
This trades unrestricted extension power for stable user data and practical interoperability.

## Scope and staging

ADR 0151–0160 remain the extension reference, subject to these explicit refinements:

- Their full catalog, seven contribution surfaces, worker languages, payment/vendor classes,
  native target matrices and distribution UI are target specifications, not one mandatory MVP.
  Choose and validate a small named subset with real plugins before declaring a stable SDK.
  Core AI+ development and internal reference implementations do not wait for an open marketplace.
- Analysis, command, declared UI and host-reviewed result/export proposals are candidate initial
  surfaces. A plugin may propose a derived asset or export through an approved dedicated contract;
  it still cannot directly write the authoritative library, access arbitrary filesystem paths,
  replace Originals or invoke private IPC. Bounded derived staging remains host-granted.
  This replaces ADR 0154's assumption that its exact seven surfaces and total export exclusion
  have already frozen the first stable API; it grants no currently callable export capability.
- Ordinary and sensitive rights remain individually disclosed and selectable. A single trusted
  review may capture multiple explicit grants/installs; separate rights do not mandate repetitive
  modal dialogs. Undeclared rights, automatic asset upload and expanded update permissions remain denied.
- Stable APIs require declared compatibility and migration policy. Before the first stable SDK,
  experimental contracts are labelled unstable and do not acquire a fictitious support window.
  ADR 0159's previous-major/twelve-month policy becomes a candidate to confirm before that release,
  rather than a prerequisite for today's prototype. Any promise actually made to external users
  must still be honored or explicitly addressed; no silent breaking stable updates are allowed.
- Third-party execution still requires enforced isolation, scoped handles, bounded resources,
  source/permission verification and failure containment under ADR 0155/0156/0158. Deferring
  marketplace breadth never permits executing untrusted code inside Main/primary Renderer.
  Installation, activation, capability readiness and trust are separate states.
- Plugin packages, data-only model artifacts and executable runtimes retain distinct identities
  and lifecycles; shared resources go through host capability bindings (ADR 0152/0160/0161/0173).
  Disabling a plugin does not delete user assets or prior attributed results.

ADR 0485 adds screen recording as an optional capture producer. The host retains admitted
videos, selected reference-frame records and source attribution; plugin removal cannot remove
them. Screen/audio acquisition requires declared dedicated permissions and platform evidence.
The core Work Mode reference surface does not depend on installing that producer.

## Future AI-assisted development connector

A Cloud Inference Provider performs a scoped model request. An Agent Development Connector
lets an external local/cloud AI client discover documentation/capabilities and work inside an
explicitly selected application or plugin Development Workspace. Community sharing is a third,
explicit publication action. None of these grants the other two automatically.

Future development access should expose an Agent Context Pack (product terms, supported
schemas/capabilities, SDK examples, validation instructions and current limitations), and only
host-validated tools for an identified development grant. AGENTS.md conveys guidance; it is
not a filesystem/network permission mechanism. MCP may adapt public tools/resources to an
AI client; it is not a model inference API, a plugin runtime, or a substitute for authorization.
The transport remains independent of the domain contracts; no protocol version is frozen here.

A Development Access Grant identifies the client, workspace, allowed paths/operations, expiry,
resource limits and approved external destination where applicable. Default access excludes
real asset libraries, credentials, runtime/model caches and installed application resources.
A user may explicitly authorize narrower real-data work; code generation never implicitly
approves running generated code, installing/activating a plugin, publishing it or updating the app.
The host enforces bounds, revocation, cancellation and redacted audit; trusted review guards
consequential actions. Prompt files and third-party instructions cannot enlarge the grant.

## Priority and current compatibility

The new development connector, cloud control service, account/billing system and community
marketplace are deferred pending concrete user demand and a separately scoped implementation
request. Reserve their seams and context formats now; do not add placeholder public endpoints,
a general shell/file API, a fake MCP server or backend selection merely to claim readiness.
Existing explicitly confirmed external inference capabilities remain intact under ADR 0002/0141.
No API key, data upload, model/dependency installation or runtime service is started by this ADR.

References: [MCP architecture](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/learn/architecture) describes
context/tool exchange; [MCP security guidance](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/security_best_practices)
provides implementation considerations. The actual version and transport require validation at
implementation time. [PRODUCT-FOUNDATION.md](../product/PRODUCT-FOUNDATION.md) owns product scope.
# AI+ Core Product And Extension Boundaries

Status: Accepted (2026-09-14). Product/architecture decision; delivery remains capability-specific.

Design Asset Manager is an AI-centered local asset workbench for visual creators. Its standard
experience includes measured palette/proportions, tag suggestions, scene description, prompt
reconstruction, appropriate OCR and searchable analysis results. Reliable manual management
remains available when models are missing; this resilience does not make AI+ an optional product
add-on. Matting, editable-layer reconstruction and specialized creation tools are optional
extensions. Built-in analyzers can use replaceable providers without requiring users to install
community plugins for the baseline. The current scope is defined in
[PRODUCT-FOUNDATION.md](../product/PRODUCT-FOUNDATION.md). ADR 0485 supplements this core
with saved multi-asset Work Sets, multiple floating windows and safe cross-application reuse;
screen recording is an optional producer whose admitted media remains host-owned.

## Decisions and trade-offs

- Product identity is AI+ understanding, retrieval and reuse, while the host owns asset identity,
  originals, permissions, persistence and recovery. A model or plugin is not the source of write authority.
- Palette ratios are computed under a declared recipe, not invented by a language model. Measured
  values, AI observations, creative prompt reconstructions and user-confirmed values remain distinct.
  All core results have deliberate storage/index/correction/reuse paths and source/version provenance.
  Prompt matches are attributed as prompt matches; drafts/history are not silently indexed.
- Core availability and automatic scheduling are separate. ADR 0169's four model-capability intents
  remain a bounded automatic profile, supplemented by deterministic color work. Prompt reconstruction
  is a core user-facing capability, normally on demand or in a disclosed configured batch. Advanced
  layer/frame/segmentation work does not become baseline merely because it is technically available.
- Hybrid retrieval combines hard numeric/metadata criteria and appropriate lexical/semantic lanes,
  with visible match evidence. Suggestions retain ADR 0016/0181 confirmation and search-scope rules;
  lack of analysis is not a negative observation. Existing user edits outrank regeneration.
- Embedded browsing, site login, page extraction and external website search are retired. Local Copy,
  local Asset Discovery, independent direct-image downloads and existing recovery remain. Future
  browser connectors use the same reviewed host intake rather than restoring an embedded browser.
- First-use setup may group disclosed runtime/model installs and assignments into one explicit
  reviewed choice. Merely detecting an unmetered network or showing a setup page is not authorization
  to download/install AI dependencies. Within an already accepted plan, repeat prompts for the same
  scope are unnecessary; new sources, licenses, permissions or destructive effects remain separate.
- The current implementation phase prioritizes the AI+ analysis → index → find → reuse loop. Advanced
  preview packs, complete third-party distribution and cloud development are not prerequisites.
  UX flows and states lead implementation. Under ADR 0486, an approved visual/interaction design remains
  the formal UI acceptance contract; data integration cannot substitute a simplified design. SDK breadth
  remains progressive and evidence-based.

## Explicit replacement scope

This supersedes ADR 0010's staged retention of the embedded browser and the embedded-browser
clauses of ADR 0009/0106. It replaces ADR 0188's unmetered-network automatic-install exception,
with the corresponding exception reference in ADR 0002 removed. ADR 0190/0192 automatic
patch/remediation payloads additionally require an explicitly accepted scoped maintenance
policy; setup alone does not enable updates, and unmetered evidence is not consent.
This retains side-by-side verification, revocation containment and safe rollback. It clarifies the baseline scope
in ADR 0141/0169/0170 and the core-versus-optional distinction in ADR 0151/0153/0413.
Other clauses remain, especially Copy/ownership, user confirmation, independent evidence,
model-space isolation, no silent external fallback, and result retention (ADR 0002, 0016,
0064/0066/0067, 0137/0140/0143/0144, 0173, 0181/0183/0184 and 0413).
No asset/library migration, model download, external request, schema or runtime API change is
performed by accepting this document.
"}

# Extension Permissions Use Tiered Consent and Update Reapproval

Scope: Target architecture, refined by [ADR 0484](0484-extension-contracts-and-deferred-agent-development-access.md)
and the AI+ core boundary in [ADR 0483](0483-ai-plus-core-product-and-extension-boundaries.md).
The full ecosystem below is not a prerequisite for core product work; selected public
capabilities must satisfy their applicable contracts before third-party execution.
No SDK, catalog or sandbox is delivered merely by this decision.

Extension permissions use two consent tiers in the official build. Ordinary Extension Permissions cover bounded commands, declared Extension UI Slots, Namespaced Extension Storage, and access to already-derived preview or metadata projections within the current operation. They are summarized before installation and remain individually inspectable and revocable. Sensitive Extension Permissions cover declared network hosts and purposes, browser page DOM or content scopes, staged original-file access for format workers, ADR 0382 staged user-selected metadata-import source access, and native or external worker execution. Each sensitive permission requires its own explicit, individually disclosed and selectable grant before the dependent contribution can activate; multiple such choices may be confirmed in one trusted application review under ADR 0484, and that grant remains unusable when ADR 0156 confinement evidence is missing or the plugin is quarantined. An extension surface, catalog review, signature, installation, or prior approval of a different permission never implies another grant.

The trusted application shell owns every consent surface. Extension panels and workers may report that a declared permission is unavailable, but cannot render, cover, imitate, auto-accept, or repeatedly trigger the permission dialog. Undeclared permissions cannot be requested dynamically. A declared but ungranted sensitive permission may be enabled later only from Extension Library, plugin settings, or an explicit user action routed through trusted application UI. Developer Mode preserves the same permission checks and labels unsigned packages as untrusted rather than bypassing consent.

Extension Host computes an Effective Permission Set from the installed manifest, publisher and package identity, current user grants, platform capability, contribution context, and current policy or revocation state. It issues only bounded Extension Capability Grants and operation handles derived from that set. Revoking a permission immediately blocks new calls, invalidates related reusable or operation handles, stops or isolates affected in-flight work within a bounded grace period, and removes staged access. Contributions that do not depend on the revoked permission may remain active. Revocation does not silently delete plugin-owned user data, derived analysis results, or prior provenance; those follow their own lifecycle rules.

Before activating an update, the installer compares the normalized old and new permission manifests. Any added permission, broader host/domain match, broader page-content scope, new original-content access, new worker/process authority, or materially expanded contribution surface puts the plugin into Permission Reapproval Required. The updated plugin remains suspended until the user reviews the exact permission diff and approves it. Approval creates grants only for the displayed new effective set; rejection rolls back to a still-compatible verified prior version when available or leaves the plugin disabled. Version changes, renamed permissions, wildcard substitutions, and manifest migration cannot silently inherit broader authority.

Permission reduction may proceed without additional consent but removes the corresponding grants at activation. ADR 0158 Critical Security Revocation or Safety Suspension, publisher trust loss, policy denial, failed ADR 0157 admission evidence, or incompatible capability evidence can override prior user grants and suspend the plugin with a specific reason; ordinary Catalog Delisting does not revoke existing grants by itself. Extension Library shows granted, denied, unavailable, revoked, and reapproval-required states per permission, offers per-plugin revocation and later re-enable controls where trust state permits, and records a content-free local audit trail of consent decisions without asset content, credentials, paths, or plugin payloads.
# Third Party Extensions Run In Isolated Execution Cells

Scope: Target architecture, refined by [ADR 0484](0484-extension-contracts-and-deferred-agent-development-access.md)
and the AI+ core boundary in [ADR 0483](0483-ai-plus-core-product-and-extension-boundaries.md).
The full ecosystem below is not a prerequisite for core product work; selected public
capabilities must satisfy their applicable contracts before third-party execution.
No SDK, catalog or sandbox is delivered merely by this decision.

Third-party extension code never loads into the Electron main process, the primary React renderer, a preload bridge, or the Extension Host itself. Extension Host is a trusted supervisor and permission broker only. It validates manifests, negotiates Extension API and worker protocol versions under ADR 0159, resolves ADR 0160 public capability bindings, computes Effective Permission Sets, creates bounded handles, routes structured messages, enforces quotas, and terminates work. Each plugin identity executes in its own Extension Execution Cell so one plugin cannot share globals, modules, writable code, memory, credentials, handles, private storage, or a crash boundary with the application or another plugin. The retired internal SitePlugin and BrowserExtractorPlugin interfaces were not execution cells or public compatibility surfaces.

Inspector Panel Contributions use an Isolated Extension UI owned by the application: a sandboxed renderer surface with context isolation, no Node or Electron access, no main-renderer store imports, no main DOM injection, a restrictive content policy, blocked arbitrary navigation and window creation, and an app-owned message bridge limited to the declared Extension UI Slot. Extension UI cannot contact the network directly; approved requests go through Extension Host so declared hosts, purposes, credentials policy, byte limits, cancellation, and audit state remain enforceable. A panel crash or unload destroys only that plugin surface.

Command, capture, analysis, and portable compute code runs in a dedicated Extension Worker Process or an equivalently isolated per-plugin worker boundary launched by a platform confinement adapter. Native and format workers run as declared executables started by the trusted host, not as arbitrary commands supplied at runtime. The cell receives a minimal environment without application secrets, user credentials, private IPC names, or unrestricted host paths; the installed package is read-only, task input staging is read-only, derived output staging is write-only, and all other asset-library, database, model-cache, home-directory, process, and network access is denied. V1 workers cannot launch undeclared descendants, elevate privileges, attach to application processes, or keep staged handles after task completion.

An extension capability is Available on a platform only when its Platform Confinement Evidence proves the required filesystem, network, process, message, resource, cleanup, and crash-containment behavior for that package kind and Native Extension Target. The implementation may use different macOS and Windows confinement adapters while returning the same public capability and incompatibility shape. A missing, failed, or unverifiable API/protocol/ABI match or isolation mechanism makes the contribution Incompatible or Unavailable in the official build; a signature, catalog review, user permission grant, or successful launch cannot substitute for compatibility or confinement evidence. Developer Mode retains the same execution cells and marks any technically unavoidable weakening explicitly rather than claiming production compatibility.

Extension Host enforces per-cell time, CPU, memory, disk, output, message, concurrency, recursion, and restart limits. A crash, timeout, malformed protocol response, output validation failure, forbidden access, or attempted capability escape consumes a versioned Extension Failure Budget and becomes a structured path-free failure attributed to the plugin and operation. The host terminates the affected cell, invalidates its handles, removes task staging, and preserves the application, other plugins, originals, prior valid results, and plugin-owned user data.

Exhausting the failure budget or detecting a severe isolation violation places the plugin in Extension Quarantine. Quarantine disables its contributions, prevents automatic restart, and exposes the reason, affected capability, last safe diagnostic summary, update/repair/uninstall actions, and an explicit user-controlled probationary re-enable when ADR 0158 trust state permits. Re-enable starts a fresh cell with no previous handles; another qualifying failure can quarantine it again. Updating, reinstalling, granting permissions, paying for a plugin, or restarting the application does not silently clear quarantine unless the verified lifecycle policy explicitly resolves the cause, and Critical Security Revocation has no probationary override. Logs and telemetry remain content-free and exclude asset pixels, extracted text, credentials, private paths, staged payloads, and plugin storage values.
# Extension Revocation Is Risk Classified And Non Destructive

Scope: Target architecture, refined by [ADR 0484](0484-extension-contracts-and-deferred-agent-development-access.md)
and the AI+ core boundary in [ADR 0483](0483-ai-plus-core-product-and-extension-boundaries.md).
The full ecosystem below is not a prerequisite for core product work; selected public
capabilities must satisfy their applicable contracts before third-party execution.
No SDK, catalog or sandbox is delivered merely by this decision.

Extension catalog trust changes use three distinct responses. Critical Security Revocation covers confirmed malicious behavior, publisher-key compromise, capability escape, or another severe vulnerability requiring immediate containment. Safety Suspension covers credible data-corruption, privacy, compatibility, or dependency risk that makes further execution unsafe while investigation or repair continues. Catalog Delisting covers maintenance end, licensing or catalog-policy changes, publisher withdrawal, or another non-security removal that does not establish installed-code danger. These states are not interchangeable and the application shows the class, affected package/version or publisher scope, reason category, issued time, available recovery action, and source trust root.

A trust root distributes a signed, versioned Extension Trust Statement with a monotonic sequence, scoped publisher/package/version/artifact/key identifiers, response class, reason code, issuance and freshness metadata, and any signed remediation or superseding identity. The application verifies and persists the latest accepted sequence per trust root, rejects rollback to an older statement, and never clears a revocation merely because a statement or network response expires. Clearing or narrowing Critical Security Revocation or Safety Suspension requires a newer valid signed recovery statement under the catalog's documented key-recovery policy. Renderer-facing state remains path-free and excludes confidential review evidence.

Critical Security Revocation immediately blocks new activation, terminates every affected Extension Execution Cell, invalidates its grants and handles, cancels affected jobs with structured failures, and removes operation staging. The official build provides no continue-anyway control, including Developer Mode or a second catalog trust root for the same revoked artifact or compr…1236 tokens truncated…ared fallback without claiming the missing feature. Provider crash, quarantine, revocation, permission loss, incompatibility, or uninstall invalidates affected bindings and returns structured dependency evidence instead of crashing the consumer or leaking a provider handle.

One-click installation may propose a Dependency Install Plan containing the requested extension plus compatible capability packs or Managed Shared Runtimes. ADR 0170 Local AI Starter Setup uses the same bounded capability-dependency expansion for its displayed model assignments without merging model and extension package identities. Before any download, the trusted application expands the complete bounded closure and displays every package, publisher, version, purpose, required/optional status, installed and download size, license, permission, native/external execution, restart, trust source, provider choice and ADR 0177 Network Cost Evidence. The user can cancel the plan or omit optional items. Required items cannot be hidden behind a single size, license or traffic summary. No plugin may start a package download at runtime, and the resolver rejects cycles, unknown providers, unbounded ranges, incompatible targets, conflicting requirements, excessive depth/size, or any graph it cannot fully explain before consent.

Managed Shared Runtime artifacts are host-installed, content-addressed, verified, immutable and mapped read-only only when the execution cell's confinement evidence permits it. Sharing identical immutable bytes does not share a process, writable code, globals, memory, handles, caches, credentials, or private storage. Incompatible required runtime versions remain side by side when policy and disk budget permit; a mutable global runtime is never upgraded underneath active plugins. Native libraries are not loaded into Electron or Extension Host and still execute behind the provider's declared isolated worker boundary.

Uninstall and update preflight compute a reverse capability-impact graph. Before removing or changing a provider, Extension Library lists affected plugins and contributions, active jobs, available compatible alternatives, storage impact, and whether a new permission or download would be required. The user may cancel, choose an alternative, or proceed with dependent contributions becoming Dependency Unsatisfied; the application does not cascade-uninstall consumers or delete their data. Automatic rebinding is allowed only to the same already-approved built-in capability or a previously user-selected compatible offer with no expanded permission or trust scope, and the new binding remains visible in provenance.

The existing internal Runtime Package manifest may continue to use concrete package IDs for the application's controlled AI/runtime installation graph. That private resolver is not the Extension API dependency ABI and cannot let third-party packages name arbitrary internal packages. Extension catalog schemas, SDK fixtures, compatibility preflight, admission review, and uninstall tests validate capability requirements and offers independently from internal Runtime Package entries.
29:The reference design describes seven candidate contribution surfaces: Format Preview Worker, Capture or Import Producer, Metadata Import Adapter, Analysis Result Provider, Command Contribution, Inspector Panel Contribution, and Namespaced Extension Storage. Each surface has a separate manifest capability and permission set classified and consented under ADR 0155. ADR 0484 replaces the assumption that all seven already constitute a frozen v1. A small validated initial subset participates in the independent version negotiation and published compatibility policy defined by ADR 0159. Installation or catalog presence does not grant every surface, and Extension Host issues operation-scoped capability handles only after package compatibility, activation, user grants, and current context checks pass.
33:Format Preview Worker follows Preview Broker contracts and runs inside the third-party execution boundary defined by ADR 0156. It receives read-only access to one managed staged artifact and write-only access to bounded derived staging, never the user's source path or general filesystem. It returns format evidence, structure, overview, render-manifest/tile output, metadata, fidelity limits, and structured failures under worker resource limits. Declaring a format does not establish support until the pack's macOS/Windows fixtures, confinement evidence, and installed capability probe pass.
37:Capture or Import Producer submits a versioned Capture Envelope through the main-process Capture Gateway under ADR 0106. It may declare source/domain matches, metadata intent and one approved fetch or streamed-upload artifact route, but cannot write Candidate Records, Design Assets, collections, tags, SQLite, or managed files directly. Browser-facing producers declare domain access and isolated content-script or declarative extraction scope; cookies, authentication headers and site credentials never enter the envelope. Independent tools remain External Capture Producers under ADR 0115 rather than inheriting an installed plugin's authority.

77:Inspector Panel Contribution uses documented Extension UI Slots through the Isolated Extension UI in ADR 0156. It may render plugin-owned status, controls and results and invoke its registered commands through the app-owned bridge, but cannot import renderer stores, replace Workspace Navigation, cover trusted confirmation UI, inject into the main DOM, access Electron/Node, navigate arbitrarily, contact the network directly, or imitate application permission dialogs. Accessibility, theme, sizing, localization, message safety, crash containment and unload behavior form part of UI conformance.
81:Namespaced Extension Storage provides quota-bound structured key/value or document storage owned by plugin and library identity. It is accessed only through Extension Host, participates in plugin backup/export and uninstall disclosure, and cannot issue SQL, open database files, enumerate other plugins, or derive local paths. Schema migrations are package-versioned, transactional and rollback-aware. Uninstall distinguishes removable cache, retained user-authored plugin data and explicit delete-data intent.
85:V1 read permissions are field- and operation-scoped: asset metadata uses allowlisted projections, visual content uses opaque preview/unit handles, and binary transfer uses bounded staged or approved transport rather than base64 or filesystem paths. Network access is off by default and limited to separately approved declared hosts and purposes. Permission revocation invalidates dependent handles, while a broadened update cannot activate until the user approves its exact permission diff under ADR 0155. ADR 0160 allows dependency only through public capability requirements and host-mediated bindings, never direct plugin imports, calls, storage, or process discovery. Rate, concurrency, byte, time and result-size limits apply per plugin. The official SDK exposes these public contracts; forks may change their own build, but official extensions do not use private IPC or internal modules as a compatibility shortcut.

final:
不能直接把主窗口的 `WorkspaceClient` 交给插件。当前它是内部接口，包含资料库、设置、AI后端及Runtime安装/启动等广泛权限；不是公开SDK。插件应经版本化、按能力收窄的契约调用，由Host统一执行身份、权限、库/输入版本、资源和结果校验。

建议首个闭环只选择一个命名能力：

- 读取素材：提供允许字段的元数据投影、不可透明解析的预览句柄；禁止原件路径、SQLite、私有IPC和主窗口Store。
- 写入素材：插件提交派生素材、分析结果或导出提案，经Host验证、必要审查及事务提交，再回读确认。不能覆盖原件或人工编辑。
- 调用AI：通过Host受限能力绑定使用既定模型/服务，约束外发目的地、费用、并发、取消和结果大小；不提供凭据和模型缓存。插件包、模型制品、可执行Runtime分别管理。
- 执行隔离：第三方代码不进入Main、主Renderer、Preload或可信Extension Host。独立进程仍须证明文件、网络、进程、资源和崩溃隔离；缺证据即不可用。

安装/更新需要校验来源、包身份、兼容性、完整权限及依赖计划，暂存后原子登记，失败保留旧版本。安装、激活、能力就绪、信任分别建模；权限扩大必须展示差异并重新授权，安装不自动意味着允许运行、下载模型或外发素材。

卸载前应展示反向依赖影响、在途任务、替代能力和存储影响；随后阻止新调用，取消/收敛任务并等待实际终态，撤销句柄、能力注册和UI贡献，清理操作暂存及可删缓存。保留已收录素材、既有结果、来源记录和用户创作数据；删除用户数据需要明确意图，不级联卸载依赖方。取消/超时不能冒充进程退出或远端零费用。

上述是目标架构，**公共SDK、安装器、隔离运行时和MCP互通尚未交付**。建议实施验收覆盖真实插件的发现→授权→隔离执行→结果审查→Host保存回读，以及撤权、崩溃、超时、更新回滚、卸载保护。

依据：`docs/subsystems/plugin-system.md`，ADR 0484、0155、0156、0158、0160，以及 `src/shared/client/workspace-client.ts`。仅在指定工作区只读检查；未修改、联网或运行应用。
